description: This EOB holds an office visit and an acupuncture visit past the yearly visit limit. The acupuncture line is correctly denied, but the EOB prints no appeal rights section, which a denial requires. An auditor should conclude that the EOB must describe the plan's review procedures and their time limits.

sources.what: Content of a notice of adverse benefit determination (every EOB that pays less than billed)
